notes: colourMatik 1.7.4 — no more ruined skies: the match judge now looks at the actual frame, not just the colour statistics. A reference with no sky could force a wide shot's blue sky through banded sepia (the distribution candidate won the statistical score while posterising smooth gradients). Candidates that roughen regions the source renders smooth are now heavily penalised, so the clean curve-based match wins on mismatched content while a genuinely good distribution match keeps winning on compatible clips.
